title: AEP NL state and handoff freshness alignment
scope: Synchronize state Git/fingerprint bindings when creating handoff and diagnose drift
alternatives: Only document state as advisory while takeover ignores it
impact: Older handoffs become stale until regenerated; state changes become part of handoff evidence
counter_evidence: State is still a local file and synchronization is not a replacement for signed transactional storage
acceptance_criteria: Takeover and doctor flag handoff-new/state-old; newly created handoff has aligned state binding
rollback_reference: Revert the state-handoff alignment commit and regenerate governance artifacts.
